lines.text: کند در ان ایام مترصد تاثیر ان مقتضی باشد و از تسییر درجه طالع سال و رسیدن
lines.en: he should be observant of its effect in those days, which is required. And from the progression of the degree of the ascendant of the year and the arrival

lines.text: او در هر وقت بدلالت اصلی که در صورت طالع است غافل نباید بود و بعد از
lines.en: of it at any time to the original indication which is in the figure of the ascendant, he must not be negligent. And after

lines.text: جمیع این ملاحظتها قوام احکام داده بروی صفحه تقویم برده و هر نظر از نظرات
lines.en: all these observations, having given consistency to the judgments, he brings them onto the page of the almanac. And every aspect of the aspects

lines.text: و دیگر اوضاع که در برتر دست دهد مخصوص ماه نداند بلکه در احکام کلی نیز دخل
lines.en: and other configurations that occur in the superior [planets], he should not consider specific to the month, but rather they also have an entry in the general judgments.

lines.text: دارد چنانکه اشاره بهر کدام خواهد شد و چون یکی از اثار علوی حادث کردد مثل
lines.en: As will be pointed out for each one. And when one of the upper phenomena occurs, such as

lines.text: قوس قزح و هاله و شهب و نیازل و دیگر چیزها که در کتب احکام ثبت است و در
lines.en: a rainbow, a halo, shooting stars, meteorites, and other things that are recorded in the books of judgments, and in

lines.text: ملحمات تفصیل انها را بسیار موثر داند و هر گاه یکی از این امور دست دهد در احکام انرا
lines.en: the Malhamat (books of meteorological astrology) their details are considered very effective. And whenever one of these matters occurs, in the judgments he should

lines.text: و طرفین ان نظر کند اگر موافق احکام تقویم خود بیند البته در انمدت حکم بوقوع ان
lines.en: look at it and its two sides. If he sees it in agreement with the judgments of his ephemeris, he should certainly judge its occurrence in that period.

lines.text: حادثه کند چنانکه بطلمیوس که پیشوای اهل این صناعت است در کتاب ثمرة الفلك
lines.en: of the event he should make [a judgment]. Just as Ptolemy, who is the leader of the people of this art, in the book Thamarat al-Falak (Centiloquium)

lines.text: در کلمه پانزدهم اشاره باین معنی کرده است میفرماید که اذا وَعَدَتِ القوّة الفلكية
lines.en: in the fifteenth aphorism has pointed to this meaning. He says: 'When the celestial power promises

lines.text: بِشَيْءٍ فَاسْتَشْهِدْ عَلَيْهِ بِثَوَانِي النُّجُومِ واگر نعوذ بالله ذو ذوابه یا ذو ذنب یا دیگر
lines.en: something, seek testimony for it by the secondary stars (fixed stars or meteorological phenomena).' And if, God forbid, a comet or a tailed star or other

lines.text: علامات اتشی که ذی بقا بود پیدا شود تاثیر انرا با انکه نسبت باوضاع فلکی از فروع
lines.en: fiery signs that are enduring appear, its effect, although in relation to celestial configurations it is of the branches,

lines.text: شمرده اند بسیار قوی داند چه استادان در ان باب مبالغه بسیار نموده اند و تا
lines.en: they have counted it, he should consider it very strong, because the masters have exaggerated greatly in that chapter, and up to

lines.text: مدتهای مدید تاثیرات انرا در کتب ایراد کرده و بتجربه نیز مصدق است و نیز جمعی
lines.en: long periods they have cited its effects in books, and by experience it is also verified. And also a group

lines.text: از اعلام بعضی از علامات دیگر را در مصنفات و رسائل خود تاثیرات نوشته اند
lines.en: of the eminent ones have written the effects of some other signs in their compositions and treatises,

lines.text: مثل انکه جمع شدن گنجشک را بر درختان و بانگ کردن ایشان و اتش گرفتن زیر دیگ
lines.en: such as the gathering of sparrows on trees and their chirping, and the catching fire under the pot,

lines.text: و بانگ کردن مرغان خانگی و خود را بسیار خاریدن و طوف کردن خطاف در
lines.en: and the crowing of domestic fowls, and scratching oneself a lot, and the circling of the swallow in

lines.text: حوالی اب و بانگ کردن ایشان و ایستادن گاو روی بمغرب و یکپای را با لتمام
lines.en: the vicinity of water and their calling, and the standing of the cow facing west and [lifting] one foot completely

lines.text: بر زمین نهادن و کرگ با بادانی درامدن و موش و مور ذخیره را از وقبه خود و از
lines.en: and placing it on the ground, and the wolf entering the desert, and the mouse and ant bringing their provisions out of their holes and from

lines.text: سوراخها بیرون انداختن علامت باران دانسته اند و هم چنین بانگ کردن مگس بسیار
lines.en: throwing them out of the holes, they have considered as a sign of rain. And likewise, the buzzing of flies a lot

lines.text: در خانه و برجستن گوسفند در چراگاه و نمودن روشنائی چراغ مشابه ظلمت علامت
lines.en: in the house, and the jumping of sheep in the pasture, and the light of the lamp appearing similar to darkness, is a sign

lines.text: سرما باشد و هم چنین بزیر امدن مرغان از درخت و در اب غوطه خوردن علامت
lines.en: of cold. And likewise, the coming down of birds from the tree and diving in the water is a sign

lines.text: سرما و بارندگی است اگر اینها را نیز علاوه اوضاع سماوی دانند دور نیست چه
lines.en: of cold and rainfall. If they consider these also in addition to the celestial configurations, it is not far-fetched, because

sections.en: The meaning of 'secondary stars' is atmospheric phenomena, shooting stars, tailed [comets], and comets with locks, and the like of them. 12

summary.headline: Celestial and Terrestrial Omens
summary.text: Astrological judgment of celestial and atmospheric omens, including rainbows, halos, shooting stars, meteorites, comets, and tailed stars, with Ptolemy’s fifteenth aphorism from the Thamarat al-Falak cited as authority. Lists terrestrial signs of rain and cold, including bird, animal, insect, lamp, and household behavior.
